Name: NeatAdditions
Author: Ilyaki
Description:
[size=3]NeatAdditions is a collection of useful additions/bug fixes I wished were in the vanilla game while I was playing.[/size]

[b][size=4]Additions[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]You can preview what a floor/wallpaper will look like before applying it
[*]Gamepads can now control the fishing bob (previously only possible with the keyboard)
[*]You can fully cycle your inventory, not just the hotbar - useful if you are using a mouse [color=#ff0000][Default: Disabled][/color]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Bug fixes[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug where the top left corner of the screen would flash for a frame whenever you opened a DialogueBox
[/list]
These can all be enabled/disabled in the config.json (If the file doesn't exist, run the game with the mod installed once to create it)

[b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b]
[list=1][*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
If you have a suggestion for an addition, let me know so I can add it.
